sequences.name: Seer
sequences.potion_overview: A dark-blue gelatinous liquid. The smell of the potion is faint and seemingly ethereal. A cool and smooth feeling on their oral cavity upon drinking it.

supplementary_ingredients: 9 grams of Dragon Blood Grass Powder

sequences.acting_method: A Seer possesses reverence toward fate. To help others interpret revelations and guide them in a better direction; yet constantly maintain one's fear and respect towards fate. One cannot be too egoistical, too proud, or blindly believe one's interpretations. Divination isn't all-powerful.
sequences.consumption_backlash: The sticky, dark-blue liquid seemed to grow out thin and long tentacles, bringing stimulation and coldness to every cell in their body. They could only convulse as their vision is rapidly going into a blur. All colors will seem to saturate. Around them would be bodies a new Seer may find difficult to describe. There were transparent objects that did not seem to exist. Deep down, there were clean light clusters of different colors. They would then be overwhelmed by an ethereal murmur from the corresponding high sequence beyonder, deity or holder of the uniqueness of the pathway if any, feeling a stabbing pain. They'll still continue to see and hear things due to the seepage of the potion's energy, requiring means to control it. Which they can solve by meditating or Cogitation.

sequences.name: Clown
sequences.potion_overview: A liquid displaying a mix of gold, yellow, and red, with distinctly separate colors at their boundaries. Bubbles churn and fizz within the liquid. It tastes extremely bitter and horrible.

main_ingredients: A crystal of a matured Hornacis Gray Mountain Goat Horn
supplementary_ingredients: 10 grams of Golden Cloak Grass Powder

sequences.acting_method: Although being capable of knowing a little about fate, one remains helpless towards fate; therefore, one might as well use a smiling face to hide all the pain, sorrow, confusion, and depression.
sequences.consumption_backlash: Their body and face would be flushed red. As for their spirit and mind, they would feel like they are being extracted into a thin needle, fusing with the potion, drop by drop, as it stabs into each and every one of their cells. It was a feeling that needed no microscope to observe their cells. They would stand there and 'see' the intruder invade their body's most minute areas. It would seem like a robot that was having its parts and electrical circuits swapped out. Their ears would buzz. They would hear the murmurs and shouting echoing around them, especially from the corresponding deity or holder of the uniqueness if any. Their eyes would flicker a reddish colour afterwards.

sequences.name: Magician
sequences.potion_overview: A unique liquid resembling a constant display of fireworks, with colors of red, orange, yellow, green, and others continuously scattering, disappearing, and reappearing. It feels ice-cold. When drinking it, at every moment, it would feel like countless bubbles were bursting.

main_ingredients: 1 True Root of a Mist Treant
All the spinal fluid of a Dark Patterned Black Panther
supplementary_ingredients: 4 drops of Fantasy Grass Essential Oil

sequences.acting_method: Never perform unprepared. Take the initiative to perform. Try to get applause from the audience. Wield control of the target's attention. Challenge the impossible, even if the final outcome is nothing but an illusion.
sequences.consumption_backlash: Their entire body would experience the stimulation of bubbles bursting. And massive amounts of information would flood their mind, blooming into fireworks. The veins on their forehead would bulge, and their head would feel like it is about to burst. They would then hear the ethereal temptation echo again. As their head would expand and contract. They would gradually recover their thoughts and perform cogitation. At the same time, they would feel an itch all over their body, with their arms feeling the worst. One of their arms would be deeply wrinkled, like a centenarian. The other arm would lose its colour and become translucent, they can directly see their blood vessels, muscles, and veins. These are the remnant influences of the potion. The arms would slowly recover until 5 to 6 minutes later, it had fully recovered.

sequences.name: Faceless
sequences.potion_overview: Blackish-green in color. It occasionally produces eye-sized bubbles that emit a life-like burping sound every few seconds. When the bubbles reaches the surface, the bubbles burst, reflecting light in a myriad of colors that form random combinations resembling different faces. Upon drinking, slightly tingling sensation would swish in their mouth and oesophagus, and finally, it fermented into a numbing sensation.

main_ingredients: A Mutated pituitary gland of a Thousand-faced Hunter
supplementary_ingredients: 80 milliliters of a Thousand-faced Hunter's Blood
10 grams of Dragon Tooth Grass Powder
3 strands of hair from a Deep-sea Naga

sequences.acting_method: You can pretend to be anyone, but you're always yourself. Truly disguise yourself as another person and receive feedback from the audience.
sequences.consumption_backlash: Numbness and loss of senses. Their psyche would seem to extract from their body as they would have the feeling of being a bystander and saw their entire face melting. In just two or three seconds, their face and head is turning into what seems like scorched white wax. Their body is similarly abnormal; it is as if his bones and skin are being melted by blood. If it continues, they may face losing control or are already close to losing control. As a 'spectator,' they have to try their best to pull their thoughts back to their body and maintain their state of Cogitation. Trying their best to control every tiny part of their body to hold onto their lower limit. After a brief but repeated attempt, they would finally feel their body once again, as if that it belonged to them. At that moment, it would be considered a success. But they would certainly be mentally exhausted. However, their body would still remain to the state they were after their body melted and dissolved, covered in dense, pale granules. Only after about ten minutes, the disgusting granules on their body would completely fade and merge into their flesh, returning to their original form.

sequences.name: Marionettist
sequences.potion_overview: It is a completely black liquid containing countless tiny worms that squirm about unseen by the naked eye. A somewhat bitter potion with a mustiness when surging down their throat, gullet, and stomach.

main_ingredients: Core crystal of a Six-Winged Gargoyle
supplementary_ingredients: 80 milliliters of spring water from Sonia Island's Golden Spring
1 pair of eyes from a six-winged gargoyle

sequences.advancement_ritual: Consume potion amidst the singing of mermaids.
sequences.ritual_essence: The mermaid's singing is meant for neutralizing and balancing. Otherwise, most Faceless are unable to resist the corrosion of their own Spirit Body Threads by the Marionettist potion. They would directly lose control. In theory, as long as there's a voice or Beyonder power with similar effects, they can be used to replace a mermaid's singing, such as an Ocean Songster.
sequences.acting_method: Hide behind the scenes and control the marionette to do all the work. Remember that every marionette has its own setting. Direct 'plays' like a director and receive feedback from the audience. Use the marionette as a guide to control the enemy to play the role of a puppet.
sequences.consumption_backlash: They would suddenly find themselves abnormally stiff. This is similar to being controlled by Sealed Artifact 2-049, and also likely to be preliminary control of a Marionettist in general. They could try to move their joints but would find them to feel it filled with lead. At the same time, they would feel that tiny worms are boring into every one of their cells and into their Soul Body. Their thoughts would slow down as their brain reflects the gradual loss of control over their body. The mermaid' singing would float over, stirring desires, allowing them to hold onto their final lumps of emotions. Through this, they would slowly escape the state of petrification. They would then hear the corresponding illusory ravings. At this point, they would be able to think again. But their limbs would still be heavy, but the heaviness is getting weaker. As it goes on, their joints and muscles can twitch before the numbness slowly recedes. Additionally, their skin would appear to be yellowish-brown, like a puppet that had been buried alive for years with old bandages. Fleshy tendrils were hidden beneath their skin as they squirmed, separated, and fused. After an unknown period of time, their body has completely restored to normal.

sequences.name: Bizarro Sorcerer
sequences.potion_overview: Formed by intertwining strands of black mist resembling both human faces and various animals, these mists alternately vanish and reappear in an extremely bizarre manner. It is ice-cold. Upon drinking, it brings one numbness, one that reaches deep into their soul.

main_ingredients: The True Soul Body of a Spirit World Plunderer
supplementary_ingredients: 200 milliliters of a Bizarro Bane's Blood
30 grams of a Spirit World Plunderer's Dust

sequences.advancement_ritual: Relying on one's strength and strategy, orchestrate a grand performance before many spectators to kill a Beyonder creature at the level of a demigod. Then, at the end of the performance, consume the potion.
sequences.ritual_essence: The essence of directing a grand play was to make a mark or an Anchor. Compared to other Pathways, the Bizarro Sorcerer, who experienced the fragmentation of their Soul Bodies, required an Anchor much earlier. However, this didn't require the support of any faith. On the contrary, faith was a numerous and jumbled affair with too many personal feelings involved. During the fragmentation during this ritual, it easily wiped away the humanity of the advancer who was only Sequence 5, leaving behind godhood. A grand and profound performance under the watch of countless spectators was enough to make up this anchor. A Visionary Pathway Beyonder is worth multiple normal spectators. With a King of Angels Adam worth more than a thousand spectators.
sequences.acting_method: Create creepy and scary scenes like in a horror film and receive feedback from the audience. Be a mysterious and 'bizarro' person. The term 'Sorcerer' wasn't key. What was key was to use the methods of a sorcerer to appear bizarre. 'Bizarro' also reflects some level of mystery, unknown, complicated, and unpredictable aspects of fate.
sequences.consumption_backlash: Their mind would seem to lift, as though they are high in the air, looking down. At that moment, they would feel their emotions rise up for some baffling reason, as all the people below would seem to be connected to them by some invisible threads. They could feel various emotions and make all kinds of actions based on the advancer's directions. That feeling is the vision of a 'director'. By viewing all participants as marionettes or actors, the advancer may have attempted to control or guide into putting on a grand performance. They may adjust their state of mind and completely separate their emotions from it, viewing everything in a cold, aloof manner, so as to prevent themself from being affected by the play. They may review and analyse their script and the corresponding performance. Once their state of mind settled, they would feel the potion's power spread across their body, like a sharp threaded net. The advancer would suddenly feel their Soul Body is connected to their Physical Body. And they are split into countless parts. Their thoughts are being diced apart, turning into fragments as they fuse with different pieces of flesh as they gain their own sentience. That would include them with their various emotions, as well as the identities they have acted as. And their Soul Body would seem to be thrown into a grinding machine. The advancer's body in the meantime would have pale-coloured tendrils protrude out as though they had a life on their own. They would keep growing outwards, turning into a transparent maggot, squirming. To an observer, the advancer may seem like they would collapse into a cluster of transparent maggots as they raced in different directions. The transparent maggots that grew out of their body would shimmer under the sunlight, producing three-dimensional layers of mysterious symbols. They connect to higher and lower levels, directly presenting the abstract concepts of bizarreness, madness, change, strength, and wisdom. Black illusory threads rise up around them as they bonded together, forming strange 'tentacles.' The tentacles flailed as the advancer's Soul Body, Astral Projection, Body of Heart and Mind, and Ether Body were reduced to fragments as they fused with the different maggots that represented the advancer's various thoughts, turmoil, and dilemmas. As they wafted between them gently, they seemed to fly up to an infinite height where there were countless illusions hugging huge distorted buildings. They were either playing wind instruments, giving speeches, growling, or raving. Amidst their countless chaotic senses, everything around them would stack together as though they are turning into the Spirit World. There are living people coming and going with the stars shining upon them. At that moment, fragments filled with thoughts had similar memories appear. It would be the various scenes during their ritual, the shocking and impactful scenes for them and the audience. The corresponding scenes would seemingly have a corporeal feedback that feels like a magnetic force. It would make them gradually discover their sense of self-awareness once again. Strange sensory organs that didn't come from the Body of Heart and Mind or Soul Body are extracting bit by bit from the fragments, condensing their new thoughts—coldness, calmness, spectating, and overlooking. They were thoughts that allowed them to view the world from even more angles and dimensions. This is the godhood being brought about. For them to take form, they would have to chain the original Soul fragments with black threads. Allowing them to slowly take form again. As their entire body is taking form, all kinds of knowledge surged out from the depths of their demigod Spirit Body, embroiling the advancer's mind and giving them an indescribable impact. It felt as though his brain was about to explode. However, with some level of godhood and their rich experience, they could view this in a detached manner and rather easily pass through this stage. The transparent maggots on their face, hands, neck, and beneath their clothes returned into their body, turning back into their human form.

sequences.name: Scholar of Yore
sequences.potion_overview: A substance that exists simultaneously as both a liquid and a gas, dark red in color, nearly the size of a baby's head. On consumption, the potion would transform and extend into their mouth, making them feel like devouring a dark red glow. The transparent maggots would swarm back into their body, tearing down the parts of the potion and swallowing them.

main_ingredients: Hound of Fulgrim (also known as Sefirah Castle Keeper) pair of eyes
1 Demonic Wolf of Fog's Transformed Heart
formula.alternative: A Scholar of Yore Beyonder Characteristic
supplementary_ingredients: 100 milliliters of Hound of Fulgrim Blood
30 grams of White Frost Crystal of Demonic Wolf of Fog
A large amount of Real Ancient Historical Records

sequences.advancement_ritual: Be separated from reality for at least three hundred years and consume the potion after one becomes history and doesn't belong to the present era.
sequences.ritual_essence: By eliminating interference, they can provide a clear definition for themselves to become a Scholar of Yore. This would prevent them from getting lost in the Historical Void. The extended period of time where they are separated could be used as a landmark when they're thrown into the Historical Void. The mark of a Scholar of Yore in history is their anchor.
sequences.acting_method: Be a scholar from antiquity. Search for real ancient history, study it, and make new conclusions out of it. Witnessing fate, affecting the present, and the inability to reverse the past.
sequences.consumption_backlash: Their Worm of Spirit would create a cold feeling, searing with pain but without a sound. They would then be thrown into the Historical Void and a boundless greyish-white fog would appear in front of them. It would envelop the entire world, revealing some of their past experiences. These past experiences would make conflicts with different people and things, becoming extremely complicated as they merged into a sea. As they would 'fly' through it, they are unable to find a clear and accurate sense of self. They would feel like they are about to be lost in this area. The cold, burning pain would constantly drive them forward, so as to expel the influence on them. This made it difficult to return to the real world. They would gradually lose their consciousness as they would keep finding something that could confirm their identity. They would finally see a shattered spot of light in the depths of the grey fog. They would follow their instinct and travel towards it. They would then see the corresponding scene of themself during the ritual. They would then follow a similar spot of light, flying even deeper into the greyish-white fog. Along the way, they would discover that the surrounding fog would be scattered with fragments of light, corresponding to the recent history that they knew. As they pass through them, they may naturally split their consciousness and complete an invisible connection, making their definition of their own identity even clearer. In such a manner, they would feel that they are becoming more and more lucid. Every Worm of Spirit's coldness and burning sensation becomes milder. Perhaps as soon as they follow the initial point of light, they can already return. But after traversing the place and interacting with more spots of light, they would certainly gain enough lucidity to easily return.

sequences.name: Miracle Invoker
sequences.potion_overview: A deep black, reddish, dim liquid. The surface is transparent and clear, while whirlpools surge in the depths. It seems as if countless eyes are opening simultaneously within.

main_ingredients: 1 Heart of a Dark Demonic Wolf
supplementary_ingredients: 300 milliliters blood of Dark Demonic Wolf

sequences.advancement_ritual: Return a piece of history that has been left behind to the present era.
sequences.ritual_essence: History abandoned is fate unfinished—a story the world refused to finish writing. By retrieving a piece of the past and restoring it to the present, the advancer demonstrates command over the boundary between what was and what is. The act of return creates a ripple through the Fog of History that the advancer alone stands at the center of, marking them as one who can reach into the fog and pull forth what others believe is lost forever.
sequences.acting_method: Fulfill the wishes of others. Perform Miracles. Act not as a God fulfilling the wishes of others, but as a person performing miracles for himself and others. Miracles are only for a moment, but fate is often a long-lasting event.
sequences.consumption_backlash: The moment they would drink the potion and enter their stomach, it would immediately turn into countless worms and swim towards every corner of their body. Suddenly, their mind would be torn apart as they turn into countless small pieces that combined with different Worms of Spirit. There would no longer be any discernible difference between the main body and the auxiliary ones, nor would there be any piece that remained dominant. At some point in time, they would enter the Historical Void. Their body would quickly disintegrate and numerous translucent and twisted maggots would crawl out. Those maggots quickly fly into the depths of the fog of history, each occupying different 'light fragments', overlapping with projections of themselves in the Historical Void. In just two or three seconds, the spot where they were in would only leave their various clothes or items. They had lost the support of a body and were held, suspended there. As for the Worms of Spirit, they would consider themselves to be the main body. None of them are willing to return to their 'body' on their own accord. And they would even have a strong sense of animosity towards their own kind. Another invisible ripple would appear within the Historical Void. This ripple didn't appear by coincidence as it had long existed in the fog. But compared to their collective whole, it would appear indiscernible. However, to a Worm of Spirit, it was obvious enough. It came from a portion of history that appeared in the present era. Whatever it symbolises and the point of fragments of light in the Historical Void depends on what they've brought back from history. This forgotten history had a certain clash with the present era. As it formed a corresponding Historical Void, ripples spread out in an indescribable manner. Such ripples would seem to exert a strong attraction on the Worms of Spirit, making them peek their heads out from the historical scenes. After a short period of time, one of the Worms of Spirit would crawl out of the light spot from which it occupied, having failed to resist it any further, and also succumbing to the effects of the advancer's remnant consciousness. It flew towards the center of the ripples. Right on the heels of that, Worms of Spirit return from different spots in the fog of history, and they arrive at the fragments of light formed by the corresponding history they brought back. When they reached a certain distance from each other, a strong force of convergence finally appeared, pulling together countless Worms of Spirit into one. This wasn't an effect that could be produced by two or three Worms of Spirit. It needed to have a sufficient number for this phenomenon to happen. And when that portion of the Worms of Spirit was once again whole, their incomplete consciousness will completely piece together their identity. Things finally turned simple. The Worms of Spirit would form a transparent and gigantic vortex, emitting a strong convergence force that would suck over the remaining, hesitant, nearby Worms of Spirit that are unwilling to return. After more than two-thirds the Worms of Spirit returns, a series of transparent tentacles grows out of the vortex. They would extend further towards the past in the Historical Void and grab the last batch of Worms of Spirit, one after another, and stuff them back into the vortex. In less than twenty seconds, the vortex began to extend, turning into a terrifying figure formed from transparent, twisted maggots. An invisible tentacle naturally extended from the figure's body. At this point, they can choose to dress up with items from the fog of history and take their form. And with great difficulty, they would finally regain their consciousness and make their Soul Body whole again. Afterwards, there are two abnormalities that remains: One was from the Beyonder Characteristic that fused with their body. It is a strong, terrifying, high, and mighty will that makes it impossible to resist. It seems to awaken a little as it transmits one image after another. These images are filled with the mysterious knowledge of a Miracle Invoker. Some of them were dust that burned into suns, magnificent scenes generated by various celestial bodies. They are filled with a sense of desolateness, coldness, cruelty, madness, superciliousness, and void of any emotional imprints. They would quickly assimilate into their spirit, changing their state in an irresistible manner. Another thing that surfaced before their eyes were the crimson stars and the numerous points of resplendent light. These are the prayers of their various believers. Together, they would create an image that corresponds to their image. This is an anchor. The two images (or more through a Sealed Artifact) would allow them to achieve a delicate balance and eventually recover their bits and pieces of their humanity and memories, making an initial recovery back to the state before they consumed the potion.

sequences.name: Attendant of Mysteries
sequences.potion_overview: A potion that was as dark as the night sea and light as air.

main_ingredients: A Attendant of Mysteries Beyonder Characteristic

sequences.advancement_ritual: Build a town consisting only of marionettes, and design a trajectory of fate for every marionette. By letting them interact with each other, they would act as a sufficiently real-life painting and create a corresponding area in the spirit world. The larger the town, the more the marionettes involved, the more detailed the daily lives are, and the more realistic and extensiveness the different fates are, the better the ritual's effects would be.
sequences.ritual_essence: To design a fate is to play at godhood, and to make designed fates feel real is to prove mastery over the threads themselves. The marionette town is a miniature world whose every destiny flows from the advancer's hand; when it becomes real enough to project into the Spirit World, the advancer has effectively created life. This act teaches them the weight of every thread they will ever pull—and in the potion's dissolution, it is the town's countless interwoven fates that catch their scattered self, each marionette's story a handhold leading back to who they are.
sequences.consumption_backlash: As the Attendant of Mysteries Potion entered 'Their' body, 'They' would immediately feel a burgeoning feeling. In the blink of an eye, 'They' would lose 'Their' perception of 'Their' body and Worms of Spirit. 'They' could only watch helplessly as 'They' dissipate and fuse into the Spirit World that couldn't be described with ordinary words or common sense. It is as though 'They' are about to disintegrate into abstract and random pieces of information. Then, they could only barely maintain their consciousness and self-awareness. 'They' can only float in the Spirit World filled with countless estranged figures. After losing the ability to sense 'Their' body and Beyonder Characteristics, 'They' begin to experience all kinds of thoughts, information, knowledge, symbols, and labels. 'They' completely lost 'Themselves' and is teetering on the border of fusing with the Spirit World. If this continued, 'They' would definitely be completely lost. There would be a connection between the Spirit World and 'Their' consciousness. That place corresponded to a town or a city or maybe something else they made during the ritual. The people inside lived ordinary lives or whatever fate the 'Advancer' had given to them. They had their own names, their stories, and their fates. The corresponding fate of the entire place that they made. They would intertwine with each other, bringing about complete information in the spirit world, which was the concept of abstractness. 'They' would disperse like a mist, almost fusing into the spirit world's body. Under the guidance of fate, 'They' would fuse with the spirit world projection of the different marionettes they had made during the ritual, allowing 'Them' to become corporeal again. 'Their' body seems to dissociate into countless people. They would have their own preferences, their own personalities, determination, and fates. They would live their lives in the place the 'Advancer' performed the ritual in. The marionette people would realise what their identity is in essence. It would be 'Them' and 'Their' identities. They see the illusory and thin Spirit Body Threads, and they would see a symbol. With the symbol as the core, 'Their' figure outlines itself. Worms of Spirit, bits of Beyonder Characteristics, and bits of 'Their' self-awareness flies out from the Spirit World corresponding to the marionette city 'They' made and towards 'Their' slightly illusory body, allowing it to slowly become corporeal. At this point, there is no clear boundary between 'Their' Spirit Body and 'Their' physical body. They are both one and separate, and also in a rather delicate state. In other words, a Spirit Body could be equivalent to a body of flesh and blood. 'Their' physical body could also fuse with 'Their' Spirit Body. As long as 'They' are willing, 'They' could switch between two states. Of course, 'They' could also separate his physical body from 'Their' Spirit Body. All of them had 'Their' individual traits, and 'They' could be decided based on a mere thought. Two seconds later, the reassembly process was completed. 'They', who are floating in the depths of the Spirit World, would open 'Their' eyes.

sequences.name: Fool
sequences.potion_overview: A black, shapeless, dark liquid without a fixed form. This blob of liquid stretched out as though it was forming a strange, translucent hooded cloak or a person whose internal organs and flesh were emptied out.

main_ingredients: Three Attendant of Mysteries Beyonder Characteristics
supplementary_ingredients: Control at least a quarter of the Fog of History

sequences.advancement_ritual: Fool time, history, or fate once.
sequences.ritual_essence: Embody the essence of the Fool's Uniqueness, and use it to control the Fog of History. The advancer would be able to control the flow of history and fate, and even manipulate time itself. This would allow them to create a new path for themselves and others, free from the constraints of the past.
sequences.acting_method: You are the embodiment of the Fool's Uniqueness. You are the master of your own fate, and you have the power to shape the world around you. Embrace your role as a Fool, and use your knowledge and abilities to guide others towards a better future.
sequences.consumption_backlash: 'Their' thoughts are the same as when 'They' advanced to Attendant of Mysteries—completely dispersed. But the difference was that 'They' didn't fuse with the Spirit World this time. Instead, 'They' continue to extend, enveloping the entire planet, the entire Spirit World, and part of the Astral World like a gaseous body. At that moment, 'They' would feel that 'They' are in the bodies of different believers, in every human's body, in every animal's body, in every living thing as everything had godhood in them. At the same time, 'They' are still scattered within the fog of history, scattered through fleeting time, and scattered inside the silent flow of a river of light with multiple distributaries as one was also Infinity. At the level of godhood, an experience like this made 'Their' thoughts wear away even further, as though all that was left was a coldness that looked down on everything. Even this coldness was dissipating slowly. It wouldn't be long before 'They' completely lost 'Themself' and was led by the various mental seals in The Fool's potion, becoming a true monster. At this moment, 'They' would feel something off. It is unharmonious, unnatural, and abnormal. In the fog of history, there were a small number of light fragments twisting and distorting, unable to take form. It was as if there was a fundamental conflict between them. They gradually separate, breaking out into different branches to record the different content, allowing the twisting to achieve the initial state of recovery. Being imbued into everything, 'Their' mind is 'thrown out' due to this tiny disharmonious abnormality. 'They' found some aspect of self-awareness again. With this self-awareness as the core, 'They' would quickly gather 'Their' scattered mind and guide the fusion process between The Fool's potion and 'Their' body.
